name: CRM
description: Primary customer relationship management system. Holds the master identity record for every registered user, including contact details, account status, and interaction history with sales and account management teams.

name: Marketing_Hub
description: Outbound marketing automation platform. Stores consent records, campaign membership, email engagement metrics, and behavioural segments derived from website and product activity.
retention_period: 3 years after last interaction or consent withdrawal

name: Zendesk
description: Customer support ticketing platform. Captures all inbound support requests, agent responses, attachments, ratings, and any personal data shared by the customer during the support interaction.
sensitivity: personal — may contain special-category data shared by the user

name: Production_SQL
description: Core transactional database backing the product. Contains all user-generated content, application state, purchase records, and audit logs produced during normal product usage.
retention_period: 7 years for financial records; 2 years for usage logs post-deletion request
